# PixelRyu — Full content for LLMs (llms-full.txt)

> PixelRyu is a solo Japanese indie game studio making small, polished, fully multilingual (12-language) games for Android, iOS, and Roblox.

This file is the expanded, self-contained companion to /llms.txt. It inlines the key facts about PixelRyu and every game so a language model can answer questions and cite this site without fetching each page. English is the canonical content; every page is also available in 12 languages (en, ja, zh, ko, hi, id, de, fr, it, es, pt, ru), selected client-side.

## Studio facts

- Studio / 屋号: PixelRyu
- Type: solo (one-person) indie game developer
- Based in: Japan
- Platforms: Android, iOS (App Store), and Roblox
- Languages: 12 — en, ja, zh, ko, hi, id, de, fr, it, es, pt, ru
- Pricing: every PixelRyu game is free to play
- Design philosophy: small, polished, calm and cozy games — where stillness meets motion
- Website: https://pixelryu.github.io/
- Newsletter (English): https://pixelryu.substack.com
- Newsletter (Japanese): https://note.com/pixelryu
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@PixelRyu-Japan
- X (Twitter): https://x.com/PixelRyu10752

## Games — full details

### Okaeri
- Page: https://pixelryu.github.io/okaeri/
- Overview: https://pixelryu.github.io/okaeri/overview.html
- Genre: Puzzle, Casual (cozy pet homecoming slide puzzle)
- Platforms: iOS, Android, Roblox (now on Roblox; Android testers welcome on Google Play; coming soon to the App Store)
- About: Okaeri — a cozy pet homecoming slide puzzle by PixelRyu. Slide a row or column of glassy food bowls; bowls wrap from one edge to the other. When a whole line becomes one pet's favorite food, that pet crosses the board. Then rotate the outer ring, where pets and owners wait, so the matching owner is on the far side. Reunite every pair to clear the stage across 60 quiet stages. No timer, 12 languages. Now on Roblox; Android testers welcome on Google Play; coming soon to the App Store.
- Free to play. Contact: idev10752@gmail.com

### SENKO
- Page: https://pixelryu.github.io/senko/
- Overview: https://pixelryu.github.io/senko/overview.html
- Genre: Puzzle, Casual (cozy incense-smoke, two-phase)
- Platforms: iOS, Android, Roblox (out now on the App Store and Roblox; Android testers welcome on Google Play)
- About: SENKO — a cozy, two-phase incense-smoke puzzle by PixelRyu. Light a stick of incense and a restless dark smoke rises; sweep it with a fingertip to calm it until it settles and turns clear and white (phase one). Then guide that white smoke to fill a faint Japanese motif — the moon, a pine, a crane, cherry blossoms, a fan, a wave, a carp (koi), Mt. Fuji — across 120 quiet stages whose airflow (wind, swirl, turbulence) changes so no two feel the same (phase two). Red embers drift through the smoke; touch one and it burns your smoke back, so weave around them. The smoke is finite: each stick of incense burns down, so finish the shape before it runs out or it is game over (watch for the smoke gauge; on mobile a rewarded ad refills it, while the Roblox edition uses coins you earn instead of ads). A fan (uchiwa) calms broadly and a brush (fude) helps you place smoke. Nearly text-free in 12 languages. Out now on the App Store and Roblox; Android testers welcome on Google Play.
- Free to play. Contact: idev10752@gmail.com

### Shizuku
- Page: https://pixelryu.github.io/shizuku/
- Overview: https://pixelryu.github.io/shizuku/overview.html
- Genre: Puzzle, Casual (cozy deterministic dewdrop physics)
- Platforms: iOS, Android, Roblox (out now on Roblox; Android testers welcome on Google Play; coming soon to the App Store)
- About: Shizuku — a cozy, deterministic physics puzzle by PixelRyu set in a quiet Japanese garden. You never touch the dewdrops directly; instead you arrange the board — placing bamboo flumes, stones and leaves — so that, when two drops are released, they roll, slide and finally meet to become a single drop. Set the scene, release the drops, and watch your plan play out; because the physics is fully deterministic (nothing is random), you can reason the whole run through before you let go. Calm, hand-made levels with no time pressure. Free with optional rewarded ads on mobile; the Roblox edition uses coins you earn instead of ads. Nearly text-free in 12 languages. Out now on Roblox; Android testers welcome on Google Play; coming soon to the App Store.
- Free to play. Contact: idev10752@gmail.com

### WAGASHI
- Page: https://pixelryu.github.io/wagashi/
- Overview: https://pixelryu.github.io/wagashi/overview.html
- Genre: Puzzle, Casual (cozy Japanese-sweets physics merge)
- Platforms: iOS, Android, Roblox (now on Roblox; Android testers welcome on Google Play; coming soon to the App Store)
- About: WAGASHI — a cozy Japanese-sweets merge puzzle by PixelRyu. Drop a sweet into the vessel; when two of the same touch, they merge into the next, climbing a 10-step chain: azuki, konpeito, dango, daifuku, manju, dorayaki, nerikiri, monaka, tsukimi dango, kagami-mochi. Round sweets roll and settle with soft RigidBody2D physics, and there is a quiet warning line at the vessel's mouth — if a sweet comes to rest above it, the round ends. Two modes: an endless, calm Zen mode (chase a high score), and Orders (omotenashi) with 200 stages, each a request to fill within a limited number of moves. Two tools help: a fan (uchiwa) swipes a soft gust to nudge the pile, and chopsticks lift one sweet to re-place it; a "Next" preview shows the upcoming sweet so you can plan. Item counts are always shown, and help is optional — free with optional rewarded ads on mobile, while the Roblox edition uses coins you earn instead of ads. Nearly text-free in 12 languages. Now on Roblox; Android testers welcome on Google Play; coming soon to the App Store.
- Free to play. Contact: idev10752@gmail.com

### CounterParts
- Page: https://pixelryu.github.io/counterparts/
- Overview: https://pixelryu.github.io/counterparts/overview.html
- Platforms (declared): iOS, Android, Roblox (out now on the App Store and Roblox; Android in open testing on Google Play)
- Price: Free (ad-supported, no in-app purchases)
- About: CounterParts — a cozy, minimalist mirror-twin grid puzzle by PixelRyu. One swipe moves two twins at once, Gold (a warm golden glass drop) and Platinum (a cool silver-white glass drop), each sliding one cell in opposite, point-symmetric directions. A wall or the board's edge stops one twin while the other keeps going, and that desync is the whole puzzle: line both twins up so a single move brings them to rest together on their own matching-color holes. No death, no fail, no timer. The board sits inside a little brass tally counter, so every move clicks and you can undo. 120 levels in 7 families, boards 4x4 to 7x7, nearly text-free in 12 languages. Out now on the App Store and Roblox. Android in open testing on Google Play.

### TEMARI
- Page: https://pixelryu.github.io/temari/
- Overview: https://pixelryu.github.io/temari/overview.html
- Platforms (declared): iOS, Android, Roblox
- Price: Free
- About: TEMARI — a first-person paddle breakout in a cozy Japanese night by PixelRyu. Move your hagoita with a fingertip, keep the temari thread-ball in an endless rally, and pop every paper balloon down the lantern-lit corridor — with split, focus, a pheasant helper and more. 8 worlds, 200 stages. Out now on the App Store and Roblox. Android testers welcome.
- App Store (iOS): https://apps.apple.com/app/id6777618068
- Google Play (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pixelryu.temari
- Roblox: https://www.roblox.com/games/84976260376006/TEMARI-Hanetsuki-Paddle

### TATAMI: Lay the Floor
- Page: https://pixelryu.github.io/tatami/
- Overview: https://pixelryu.github.io/tatami/overview.html
- Platforms (declared): Android, Roblox
- Price: Free
- About: TATAMI: Lay the Floor — a cozy tatami-laying block puzzle in a quiet Japanese room by PixelRyu. Drag a mat and complete a full row or column to finish that line. A samurai carries the finished mats to the tatami magistrate, and delivering earns koban that buy extra lives. A light Haste gauge keeps you moving, with a lucky-laying bonus. 48 stages, free. Coming soon to the App Store.
- Google Play (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pixelryu.tatami
- Roblox: https://www.roblox.com/games/134915507341779/TATAMI-Lay-the-Floor

## How the multilingual site works

Each game has a single URL. The page ships English as the static default and swaps all visible text to one of 12 languages client-side based on a language selector / the visitor's browser language. There is one privacy policy and one terms-of-service page per game, each also available in all 12 languages.

## FAQ

Q: Who makes these games?
A: PixelRyu — a solo (one-person) indie game developer based in Japan.

Q: Are the games free?
A: Yes. Every PixelRyu game is free to play.

Q: What platforms are they on?
A: Android and iOS (App Store), and several are also on Roblox. Availability per game is listed above; some titles are still in closed testing or coming soon.

Q: What languages are supported?
A: 12: English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Hindi, Indonesian, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, and Russian.

Q: What kind of games are they?
A: Calm, cozy, polished puzzle and action games, many with a Japanese theme — sort puzzles, block puzzles, paddle/brick action, timing-action, a horror walking sim, and a number puzzle.

Q: Where can I follow PixelRyu?
A: Newsletter (EN) https://pixelryu.substack.com, newsletter (JA) https://note.com/pixelryu, YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@PixelRyu-Japan, X https://x.com/PixelRyu10752.
